mathematical_claim_groups.author: w460
mathematical_claim_groups.reproduction: In ordered coupling event discrepancy implies some edge in finite support F differs, giving delta<=sum edge-marginal gaps. For B_R, |E(B_R)|=d(2R)(2R+1)^(d-1). Under theta_w>=eta, theta_f=0 choose R so free A_R<=eta/2; symmetry gives edge gap>=eta/(2m_R). Edwards-Sokal opens a same-spin edge with probability p, hence agreement gap=edge gap/p.
mathematical_claim_groups.remaining_gap: The uniform-in-volume critical hypothesis theta_w>=eta with theta_f=0 is unproved for the missing C0048 pairs; the free condition is an additional premise.

mathematical_claim_groups.author: w460
mathematical_claim_groups.reproduction: Boundary recoloring gives 0<=log Z_free-log Z_fixed<=b log q+2d K b=o(|B_N|). For either boundary condition, convex tangent inequality survives volume limit. Bulk edge averages converge by free/wired domain monotonicity and an interior-R sandwich; limits a_f,a_w are subgradients of the common pressure P. Therefore P'_+-P'_->=a_w-a_f>=d delta/(p m).
mathematical_claim_groups.remaining_gap: No positive critical finite-event gap is supplied; a pressure jump is only a conditional consequence and needs a magnetization bridge to solve the primary conjecture.

mathematical_claim_groups.author: w460
mathematical_claim_groups.reproduction: For a path of L edges free edges are iid with alpha=p/[p+q(1-p)]. Endpoint identification multiplies free configuration weight by q iff all edges open and by 1 otherwise, up to a common factor. Thus the edge gap is (q-1)(1-alpha)alpha^L/[1+(q-1)alpha^L]. At q=3,p=1/2, gaps L=1:1/4 and L=4:1/172, tending to zero.
mathematical_claim_groups.remaining_gap: The path lies outside d>=3; it refutes the general finite-gap-to-limit inference, not C0048.

mathematical_claim_groups.author: w460
mathematical_claim_groups.reproduction: With x=exp(2nt), (2x+1)/(x+2) is in [1/2,2], so sup|g_n-f_n|<=log2/n. At t=0, derivatives are 4/3 and 2/3; both limits are 2 max(t,0).
mathematical_claim_groups.remaining_gap: Abstract finite-state counterexample; no assertion about Potts realization.
